column1: # The seam (ci/pump-seam-arm.sh) covers all 82 sites but is a WEAKER witness. ⚠️ THE
# SENTENCE THAT USED TO STAND HERE -- *"it exercises the primitive's forced path, not the
# site's own miss block"* -- WAS FALSE, and this file was the last place it survived after
# the others were fixed (#289 batch 12). What forcing does and does not exercise is stated
# ONCE, at `run_window_then_ready` in tests/support/pump_until_ready.hpp. Read it there.
# These three arms mutate the source, one per RECIPE shape, so the block as written at that
# site is what compiles and reports:
# NOTE force_site() truncates the call at its third argument, so it DROPS the site
# label. That is fine and is itself worth witnessing: the label is defaulted, the call
# still compiles, and the ADD_FAILURE that carries the label is what the driver matches.
